sealed_record.thesis: Two independent, non-price-based structural signals converge here. First, holder-behaviour: the pool flags a BTC 'Cooperation regime' — holders coordinating to accept delayed payment rather than distribute — with roughly 17 days left before a model's main allocation triggers, which is a dated, mechanical accumulation catalyst rather than a chart. Second, supply: new token issuance across crypto has collapsed from 26.5% annually in Dec 2021 to 3.3% today, so the marginal-seller pressure that capped prior cycles is an order of magnitude smaller. Layer on the cross-asset rotation argument — equities are rolling over off a 2-year-plus bull run while crypto has already cleansed leverage — and you get the non-consensus pairing of equity-down/crypto-up at a moment when everyone is treating the AI capex unwind as a risk-off event for all risk assets.

outcome.thesis_note: DITUTUP -20.3%. Ditutup dalam unwind seluruh buku call. Long kripto ikut turun bersama pasar (BTC ~$64,8 ribu).
